veranderings.rede: Two separable compound verbs sharing a past participle are written oop- en toegetrek, with a hyphen.
After 'Sipho' and 'hom', the second 'hy' could mean either boy, so naming Karabo removes the doubt (same word count); the comma is needed because both clauses have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Van die ander kinders het gedink
veranderings.na: Party van die ander kinders het gedink
veranderings.rede: 'Van die' for 'some of the' is colloquial and can read as a broken sentence to a Grade 4 reader; 'Party van die' is standard and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: Die skoot het geklap en die kinders
veranderings.na: Die skoot het geklap, en die kinders
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: saam met hom gekom al hardloop
veranderings.na: saam met hom gekom, al hardloop
veranderings.rede: A comma before the concessive clause starting with 'al' makes the sentence easier to read.
